text_en: To the leader: Do Not Destroy. Of David. A Miktam, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
text_cn: 达味金诗，交与乐官，作于逃入洞中躲避撒乌耳时。 调寄"莫要毁坏"。

text_en: Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me, for in you my soul takes refuge; in the shadow of your wings I will take refuge, until the destroying storms pass by.
text_cn: 求你怜悯我，天主，求你怜悯我， 因为我的灵魂，一心向你投靠，投靠到你翅翼的荫庇下， 等待一切凶祸过去才罢。

text_en: I cry to God Most High, to God who fulfills his purpose for me.
text_cn: 我向至高者天主呼救， 呼求施惠于我的天主；

text_en: He will send from heaven and save me, he will put to shame those who trample on me. Selah God will send forth his steadfast love and his faithfulness.
text_cn: 愿天主自天赐下慈爱，并赐下忠实， 拯救我，却对追赶我的人加以凌嗤。 （休止）

text_en: I lie down among lions that greedily devour human prey; their teeth are spears and arrows, their tongues sharp swords.
text_cn: 我躺卧在群狮的中间， 个个都想把人子吞咽； 他们的牙齿是长矛锐箭， 他们的舌头是锋刀利剑。

text_en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
text_cn: 天主，愿你的尊高，彰显于天， 愿你的光荣，普临尘寰！

text_en: They set a net for my steps; my soul was bowed down. They dug a pit in my path, but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah
text_cn: 他们为我的脚设下了罗网，要我的性命； 在我前面挖掘了陷阱，自己反跌入其中。 （休止）

text_en: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make melody.
text_cn: 天主，我的心已准备妥当， 我的心已准备妥当， 我愿意去歌弹咏唱。

text_en: Awake, my soul! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn.
text_cn: 我的灵魂，你要醒起来， 七弦和竖琴，要奏起来， 我还要把曙光唤起来。

text_en: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises to you among the nations.
text_cn: 上主，我要在万民中赞美你， 上主我要在列邦中歌颂你。

text_en: For your steadfast love is as high as the heavens; your faithfulness extends to the clouds.
text_cn: 因为你的大爱高越诸天， 你的忠信直达霄汉。

text_en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
text_cn: 天主，愿你在天上备受举扬， 愿你在地上彰显荣光！
